text:
Emma Chen: heads up — BridgeWork (adapter vendor) is ready to announce their orchestration adapter with our gateway. Need a short coordination plan for marketplace listing + joint blog + demo. Who owns which assets?
Josh Patel: +1. timeline? do we want to sync announcement with their release or staggered? :thinking_face:
Emma Chen: ideal window = week of May 12. they want same-day listing on cloud marketplaces (AWS & GCP). propose: joint blog + 20-min demo at partner webinar, marketplace listing same day.
Maria Gomez: for marketplace we need 1) listing description, 2) technical validation screenshot, 3) estimated costs, 4) logo + 72/300px versions. I'll own marketplace assets.
Liam O'Neill: I'll handle integration checklist (adapter contract, auth, telemetry). need a smoke test matrix from BridgeWork and a sample `adapter.yaml` snippet to validate.
BridgeWork Rep (via @BridgeWork): sending test matrix later today.
Tasha Rivera: legal/PR input — ask legal about co-marketing wording and embargo. also need to confirm whether we can use BridgeWork logos in press materials.
Josh Patel: engineering action items:
- provide sample config + e2e smoke script
- staging demo env + secret provisioning
- compatibility note for LangChain/LlamaIndex runtimes

Here is a minimal adapter example for the smoke test:
```
adapter: bridgework-orch
version: "1.2.0"
endpoint: https://staging.bridgework.example.com/api/v1/run
auth: api_key
params:
  concurrency: 4
  max_seq_len: 2048
```

Liam O'Neill: can you also confirm runtime compatibility? We should call out supported orchestrators (Airflow, Prefect, Singer, OrchestratorX).
Emma Chen: product-marketing needs a demo script (3 steps) + a short list of customer scenarios (NLP pipeline, multi-model routing, gateway failover). I'll draft.
deploy-bot: staging environment created: https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/bridgelab (creds shared in #eng-secure) :white_check_mark:
Maria Gomez: for AWS/GCP marketplace we also need an AMI/container reference and a short install command. Josh — can you produce container tags?
Josh Patel: yes. pushing `redwood/bridgework-adapter:1.2.0-rc` to staging registry today.
Tasha Rivera: PR note: we should prepare an embargo calendar. legal needs 72h review for copy and trademark clearance.
Emma Chen: risk register quick notes: 1) marketplace listing delays (mitigation: staged publish), 2) adapter latency surge in heavy routes (mitigation: canary in Dedicated pool), 3) joint webinar logistics (mitigation: dry-run).
Liam O'Neill: Ops note: we should enable metric tracing for adapter endpoints — add a tracing tag `partner:bridgework` and export sample spans.
Maria Gomez: marketing ask: short tagline and 2 bullets on benefits for the marketplace entry page. I can write, but need technical bullets from eng.
Josh Patel: technical bullets: 1) "Seamless orchestration connectivity — plug into common orchestrators with one config file." 2) "Optimized KV caching for cross-model pipelines to reduce token cost."
Emma Chen: action items (owners):
- Maria: marketplace assets + listing draft (due in 3 days)
- Josh: adapter container + smoke script + staging push (due EOD)
- Liam: validation checklist + telemetry hooks (due in 48h)
- Tasha: legal/PR intake + embargo calendar (due in 72h)
- Emma: blog draft + demo script + webinar scheduling (due in 5 days)

Liam O'Neill: quick Q — do we need to add a compatibility note for LangChain and LlamaIndex versions? some customers will expect exact minor versions.
Emma Chen: yes, call out tested LangChain >= 0.2.11 and LlamaIndex >= 0.6.0, mention community adapters for older versions and link to repo.
Tasha Rivera: once legal approves, I'll loop in PR and events for webinar slot.
BridgeWork Rep: thanks! we'll send the smoke matrix and logo assets in a thread today. excited to co-launch :rocket:
Maria Gomez: noted — I'll add a marketplace checklist to the shared drive and ping when ready. :eyes: 
Josh Patel: will post `smoke_test.sh` in the repo and tag @Liam for validation.
Emma Chen: great. follow-ups in this thread. please update status replies only (no long threads) so we can keep the timeline tight. :calendar:
